'''Eli James''' (born March 24) is an American voice actor who was previously involved in the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Pokémon roles==
James first started his work during {{aniseries|DP}}. Some of his most notable roles include {{ci|Sunyshore}} [[Gym Leader]] [[Volkner]] and [[Cilan's Pansage]]. James left the show part way through {{aniseries|XY}} and has since moved to the United Kingdom, living in London.
